name: shengmo-project
description: Shengmo TRPG and Novel Reader Application

scripts.postinstall: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const src = path.join('node_modules', 'monaco-editor', 'min'); const dest = path.join('vendor', 'monaco-editor'); if (!fs.existsSync(src)) { console.error('ERROR: monaco-editor not found in node_modules. Run npm install first.'); process.exit(1); } fs.rmSync(dest, { recursive: true, force: true }); fs.mkdirSync(dest, { recursive: true }); fs.cpSync(src, dest, { recursive: true }); console.log('Monaco Editor files copied to vendor directory.');"
